senses.gloss: (denom. of שפודא) to put on the spit, roast.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 111a">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>חזייה … דקא שָׁפֵיד וכ׳</he> he saw the son of R. b. A. put a liver on the spit over a piece of meat.
Pes. 74ᵇ שַׁפְדֵּיה בשפודא (or שַׁפְּדֵיה Pa.) if he put it on the spit (and roasted it).
